purpose: Separate 'structured external state helps frozen readers, more so as they scale' from 'this parser solves this benchmark' by replacing the writer with schema-free state constructions and leaving everything else fixed.
fixed: the ten official-16K confirmation panels and their hashes
the bullet-list serialisation and the reader prompt template
readers Qwen2.5-0.5B/1.5B/3B at the pinned revisions
greedy decoding, 8 new tokens, bf16, batch sizes from the frozen config
the scorer and the panel-clustered estimator with Holm family-wise control

varied.sentence_window_coscale: last s(m) generic sentences of the input (recency; reads nothing task-specific)
varied.generic_bm25_coscale: deterministic BM25-like lexical chain over generic sentences (ascent/generic_retrieval.py, unchanged)
varied.bge_m3_coscale: BGE-M3 dense + BM25 RRF with the official bge-reranker-v2-m3, three target-blind hops (experiments/prepare_babilong_bge_cache.py, unchanged; protocol re-pinned to the 16K panels)

config.note: committed with an empty retrieval_cache_by_panel map; the run copy fills in cache paths and hashes mechanically after cache generation and before any reader score; the run copy records the committed config's hash

runner_change: experiments/run_babilong_prompt.py gains memory_source 'sentence_window' (selection of the last s(m) sentences and its instruction text); no existing path is altered
hardware: NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB, UUID GPU-5b892f6f-ac8e-8c99-71ed-7efad31c6765, /venv/py3123 (Python 3.12.3, torch 2.8.0+cu128, transformers 4.57.6)
cells: 3 writers x 3 readers x 10 panels = 90 runner jobs, both arms each

analysis.same_instance_canonical_comparator: artifacts_revision/target_blindness_2026-09/official16k (Phase 2B instrumented canonical run on the same A100)

interpretation_rule.co_scaling_survives: for a generic writer, the three endpoint gains increase strictly with reader scale AND both adjacent one-sided increments pass Holm at family-wise 0.05 (the registered rule of the canonical study)
interpretation_rule.co_scaling_collapses: either condition above fails for that writer
interpretation_rule.consequence_if_all_generic_writers_colla: the schema is doing the work; the manuscript narrows the claim to structured-fact-retrieval tasks (Option B) and reports these results in Appendix D
interpretation_rule.consequence_if_any_generic_writer_surviv: the co-scaling pattern does not depend on the hand-built schema; reported as the direct answer to Reviewer 2 point 2 while still scoping the claim to the evaluated benchmarks (Option A)
interpretation_rule.schema_advantage_estimand: canonical minus generic ASCENT accuracy per endpoint, paired over the ten panels, both measured on the same A100 instance (canonical from artifacts_revision/target_blindness_2026-09), so that no GPU-architecture difference enters the contrast
interpretation_rule.foundation_invariance_check: Foundation predictions must be identical across the three generic conditions and the instrumented canonical run on the same instance (same prompts, same GPU); any difference is reported

no_number_replaced: the canonical results in the manuscript are unchanged by this ablation; it adds Appendix D and determines whether the framing is narrowed (Option B) or kept with generalisation evidence (Option A)
abort_policy: if a job aborts, its log is kept, the abort is disclosed, and the cell is re-executed once with identical settings only if the abort was an infrastructure failure (OOM, I/O); a second failure leaves the cell missing and reported as missing
